name: Configuration
description: Where a run is configured from, and what the configuration decides.

text: A run takes the nearest `.sumi.json` at or above where it started,
which is the convention tsc and RuboCop both follow: each walks up the
ancestor directories until a configuration answers.
Two bases come out of that and they answer different questions. What
the configuration says is read against the directory holding it, so
wherever under it a run starts it reaches the same files; findings
answer relative to where the run started, so a reader can go straight
The two switches sit in the same entry and are independent.
`verify: false` keeps a specification without checking it, which a
Render that only records it still needs; `render: false` keeps one out
of the documents without stopping the check.
`.spec` is the default because `spec/` is already RSpec's, and because
a directory that does not start with a dot is one a build is liable to

scenarios.title: The nearest .sumi.json decides the base
given: a .sumi.json at the top of a project
a run starting several directories below it
scenarios.then: the base is the directory holding that .sumi.json, however deep the run started

scenarios.title: With no .sumi.json, the repository it sits in
given: a project with a .git but no .sumi.json
scenarios.then: the base is the repository root, whether .git is a directory or a gitfile

scenarios.title: With neither, where the run started
given: a directory with no .sumi.json and no .git above it
scenarios.then: the base is where the run started

scenarios.title: A .sumi.json that will not parse
given: a .sumi.json that is not readable JSON
scenarios.then: the file is named as unreadable

scenarios.title: Only the exceptions are listed
given: a .sumi.json naming one specification as not to be verified
scenarios.when: the configuration is asked about each specification
scenarios.then: the specification it named is not verified

scenarios.title: A specification nobody mentioned is verified
given: a .sumi.json naming one specification as not to be verified
scenarios.when: the configuration is asked about each specification
scenarios.then: a specification the file does not mention is verified

scenarios.title: Where the rendered specification goes
scenarios.then: the documents base is that path, answered against the directory the file was found in

scenarios.title: A project that has said nothing writes to docs
scenarios.then: the documents base is `docs` under the base

scenarios.title: A specification that is kept but not rendered
given: a .sumi.json naming one specification as not to be rendered
scenarios.when: the configuration is asked about each specification
scenarios.then: the specification it named is not rendered

scenarios.title: A specification nobody mentioned is rendered
given: a .sumi.json naming one specification as not to be rendered
scenarios.when: the configuration is asked about each specification
scenarios.then: a specification the file does not mention is rendered
